mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation (id, tenant_id, hotel_id, reservation_no, source_type, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{hotelId}, #{reservationNo}, #{sourceType}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM reservation WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND hotel_id = #{hotelId} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, tenant_id, hotel_id, room_type_id, code, floor, status, housekeeping_status, notes, version, created_at, updated_at FROM physical_room r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.hotel_id = #{hotelId} AND r.room_type_id = #{roomTypeId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM room_occupancy o WHERE o.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND o.hotel_id = r.hotel_id AND o.room_id = r.id AND o.status IN ('HELD', 'CONFIRMED', 'CHECKED_IN', 'BLOCKED') AND o.stay_range && #{range}::daterange ) ORDER BY r.code

mapper.select: SELECT FROM reservation_line WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND hotel_id = #{hotelId} AND reservation_id = #{reservationId} ORDER BY line_no

mapper.select: SELECT FROM room_occupancy WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND hotel_id = #{hotelId} AND room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY stay_range
